name: Kurogane (黒鉄, "Black Iron")
concept: A Soldier-class Frame built to plant itself between danger and everyone behind it — the blunt, load-bearing violence Hiroshi never lets himself use in his own voice. Its Strike is reflavored at Frame scale as a building-sized haymaker, not a sleek weapon.
notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Mechanically grounded in GM Core pg. 121-124's real level-12 creature-building tables (AC/attack/damage/saves/perception all read directly off those tables, not invented): AC High (33), attack bonus High (+26), Strike damage High tier (3d10+14, avg 30), saves Fort High(25)/Will Expert-labeled-High(22 shown as 'expert' rank name, matching a High-tier numeric value)/Reflex Low(19), HP High tier (270). Scoped to ONE signature Strike, matching this project's established precedent (the Mystic Frame test fixture in tools/battle-simulator/data/combatants.mjs) rather than a full feat-by-feat level-12 build — a real, playable outline, not an exhaustive RAW-complete character sheet. abilityBands only has one entry to sort, since there's only one ability yet; attuned/resonant/absolute stay empty until a fuller kit exists. classAssignmentMethod is a proposal, not a resolution of data/campaign/open-questions.json's frame-class-assignment question — Ingram's still free to decide that either way; this file just needed something in the field.
